abstract: OBJECTIVE: The aim of the study was to identify the role of neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) in the treatment of the patients with advanced stage ovarian yolk sac tumor (OYST). METHODS: The comparative study was based on 53 cases with advanced stage OYST registered at Peking Union Medical College Hospital from 1995 to 2010. Twenty one cases were treated with NACT followed by interval debulking surgery (IDS). Thirty two cases were treated with primary debulking surgery (PDS). Data on patient characteristics, treatment and survival were analyzed and compared between two groups to assess the outcome of NACT. RESULTS: After NACT, the overall status of the patients was improved significantly. Patients in NACT had better optimal cytoreduction rate and less peri-operative morbidities. Seven patients (13.2%) suffered from relapse. There was a significantly better PFS for patients with ovarian tumor size >20cm in the NACT than those underwent PDS. Residual disease >2cm was the independent risk factor of relapse. CONCLUSIONS: NACT is the better treatment option for some patients with advanced stage OYST, especially for those with unresectable tumors and poor general condition.
abstract_ja: 目的：進行期卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍(OYST)患者の治療における術前化学療法(NACT)の役割を明らかにすること。方法：比較研究は、1995年から2010年にPeking Union Medical College Hospitalに登録された進行期OYST 53例に基づいている。21例はNACTに続いて中間減量手術(IDS)で治療された。32例は初回減量手術(PDS)で治療された。両群間で患者特性、治療、生存のデータを解析・比較し、NACTの成績を評価した。結果：NACT後、患者の全身状態は有意に改善した。NACT群は最適減量率が高く、周術期の合併症が少なかった。7例(13.2%)が再発した。卵巣腫瘍の大きさが20cmを超える症例では、PDS群よりもNACT群で無増悪生存期間(PFS)が有意に良好であった。残存病変が2cmを超えることは、再発の独立した危険因子であった。結論：NACTは、特に切除不能な腫瘍や全身状態の不良な一部の進行期OYST患者にとって、より良い治療選択肢である。
